svg.title: RA-001 Figure 4 — Logical Assurance Architecture for Cross-Organizational Pharmaceutical Traceability
svg.desc: Vendor-neutral logical assurance architecture connecting the physical pharmaceutical supply chain, identification and observation, authoritative operational systems, traceability semantics and exchange, boundary assurance capabilities, and regulatory or partner ecosystems. Cross-cutting evidence protection and trust lifecycle governance are shown alongside assurance outcomes and conditional evaluation of shared ledger mechanisms.

text.tspan: KryoNex Research synthesis based on GS1 EPCIS/CBV, U.S. FDA DSCSA, EU medicines-verification requirements, and Indian pharmaceutical traceability frameworks.
